extDescription.message: Pastes an approved AI Veterinary record into your practice software, after checking it is the right patient. Works offline.

step1Hint.message: In the workspace, click "Copy for the browser helper", then paste here (Ctrl+V) or read the clipboard.

refused_not_json.message: Refused: this is not an AI Veterinary export (not JSON).

refused_wrong_format.message: Refused: unknown format. Only the approved-record export from the workspace is accepted.

refused_not_approved.message: Refused: the approval details are missing. Approve the record in the workspace first.

refused_fingerprint.message: Refused: the record does not match its approval fingerprint. It was changed after approval.

refused_soap_changed.message: Refused: the S/O/A/P texts are not the ones generated from the approved record.

refused_patient_missing.message: Refused: the export has no patient name or species, so the patient cannot be locked.

refused_patient_changed.message: Refused: the patient header does not match the patient in the approved record.

siteUnsupported.message: Open your practice software in this tab first.

siteNotMapped.message: No fields mapped yet for $1. Map them once.

pickStarted.message: Now click on the page as the banner asks.

clipboardDenied.message: Clipboard not available. Paste with Ctrl+V instead.

step3Hint.message: Checks the patient shown on the page, then fills the four boxes. Nothing is saved: you save in your practice software.

privacy.message: Works only in this browser. No network requests; the record never leaves your computer. Only which page elements you picked is stored.

pick_name.message: Click the element that shows the patient name.

pick_species.message: Click the element that shows the species.

pick_S.message: Click the text box for S (Subjective).

pick_O.message: Click the text box for O (Objective).

pick_A.message: Click the text box for A (Assessment).

pick_P.message: Click the text box for P (Plan).

pickNotText.message: That is not a multi-line text box. Pick a text area.

pickEmpty.message: That element shows no text. Pick the one with the patient detail.

pastedTitle.message: Pasted. Check and save in your practice software.

rowChanged.message: the field changed the text: check it

mismatchName.message: The page shows patient "$1", the approved record is for "$2".

mismatchSpecies.message: The page shows species "$1", the approved record is for a $2.

mismatchHelp.message: Open the right patient in your practice software, or cancel. Nothing was pasted.

no_mapping.message: No fields mapped for $1. Map them first.

field_missing.message: The mapped element "$1" is not on this page. Open the consultation screen or map again. Nothing was pasted.

not_empty.message: These boxes already contain text: $1. Clear them in your practice software first; nothing is overwritten. Nothing was pasted.
